name: cyclic component forms one group with its cheapest outside production
description: x1 and x2 each derive from the other for free (like a slice of a larger tensor and its scatter back), so they form one cyclic component and one group: every plan needing out holds x1 or x2. x1 costs 3 from the input, x2 costs 5. A cycle-free plan produces some member from outside the component, so the group is worth its cheapest outside production, 3; out adds 1. The optimum is 4 (x1 from the input). Charging the group its most expensive outside production (x2's 5) would claim 6, and treating x2 as necessary on its own would claim at least 6.
